item.title: Ayush Mhatre breaks Rohit Sharma’s record with exceptional century in Syed Mushtaq Ali T20 Trophy 2025
item.description: Ayush Mhatre has broken Rohit Sharma's long-standing record. Mhatre smashed unbeaten century for Mumbai against Vidarbha in Syed Mushtaq Ali T20 Trophy 2025.

item.title: BCCI announces home schedule for Women’s T20I series between India and Sri Lanka
item.description: BCCI has revealed the schedule for the upcoming Sri Lanka Women's tour of India. The first two games of the five-match T20I series will take place in Visakhapatnam.

item.title: BCCI announces complete schedule for WPL 2026; Royal Challengers Bengaluru will battle Mumbai Indians in the opener
item.description: The fourth season of Women’s Premier League will begin on January 9. Royal Challengers Bengaluru will take on Mumbai Indians in the tournament opener in Navi Mumbai.

item.title: PAK vs SL, T20I Tri-series 2025 Final: Who will win today’s match between Pakistan and Sri Lanka?
item.description: Pakistan will face-off against Sri Lanka in the final game of the T20I Tri-series 2025. The final showdown will take place at Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium on Sunday.

item.title: WBBL|11: Meg Lanning guides Melbourne Stars to top of the table with 45-run win Melbourne Renegades
item.description: Melbourne Stars Women defeated Melbourne Renegades Women by 45 runs in the 28th match of the WBBL|11. Meg Lanning was named Player of the Match for her unbeaten 73.

item.title: BAN vs IRE, 2nd T20I Match Prediction: Who will win today’s game between Bangladesh and Ireland?
item.description: Bangladesh will face off against Ireland in the 2nd T20I on November 29. The game will take place at Bir Sreshtho Flight Lieutenant Matiur Rahman Stadium in Chattogram.

item.title: Parthiv Patel reveals his predicted India XI for 1st ODI vs South Africa; leaves out superstar player
item.description: Former Indian wicketkeeper-batter Parthiv Patel has unveiled his preferred Team India playing XI for the upcoming 1st ODI against South Africa The contest will take place at the JSCA International Stadium Complex in Ranchi on November 30.

item.title: India vs South Africa 2025: Ranchi Pitch Report, ODI Stats and Records
item.description: India will lock horns against South Africa in a three-match ODI at the JSCA International Stadium Complex in Ranchi. The series opener is scheduled on November 30.

item.title: WBBL|11: Nat Sciver-Brunt stars in Hobart Hurricanes’ 7-wicket victory over Perth Scorchers
item.description: Hobart Hurricanes Women successfully chased down 187 set by Perth Scorchers Women In a thrilling WBBL 2025 encounter at Bellerive Oval. Nat Sciver-Brunt played a match-winning knock of 81 off 48 balls.
